description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain located in Westshore Town Centre (between M&M Meats and Bulk Barn) at Kelly Road and Jacklin Road, serving the Langford, Colwood, and View Royal areas. The menu emphasizes quality ingredients including antibiotic-free chicken and pork, 100% organic tomato sauce, and daily-fresh dough. Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-smart pizza options are available alongside wings, salads, and sides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for this Panago location confirms the address as 800 KELLY RD Victoria BC V9B 5T6 (unit 114 per OSM) and phone 310-0001 matching OSM. The website explicitly states vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-smart options are available, and the ordering model is delivery/takeout. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Victoria' but the website describes the location as Langford (Westshore Town Centre, Kelly Rd & Jacklin Rd); Langford is a separate municipality from Victoria. The mailing address says Victoria BC which may contribute to the OSM tagging, but cyclists should be aware this is in Langford.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food pizza business with a confirmed website and operational location in Westshore Town Centre. Useful to touring cyclists seeking food in the Langford/Westshore area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'Panago offers vegan, vegetarian and gluten-smart options.'
